name: Veilcatch Skin
description: A Feywood water vessel of waxed barkcloth and resin-sealed Thornfiber, shaped to dock directly into the catch-pouch of a Veilcanopy Shelter. Stores collected dew runoff and rainwater rather than being filled from a stream; a fitted pour-spout and resin stopper let it serve cleanly as a drinking vessel through the day.
narrative_effects: Holds water equivalent to a full waterskin; functions as a waterskin substitute in all narrative and survival contexts.
Designed to dock with the Veilcanopy Shelter's catch-pouch for direct transfer of collected dew and rainwater without manual decanting.
Quieter, lower-snag, and more durable than a realm waterskin in dense forest terrain.
